title: JobRequirementClaim payload (Slice 1)
description: One requirement on a job. Distinctive must-have tokens drive coarse triage. Mobility (residence / visa / relocation) is always three separate rows, never one location score. Slice 1 adds optional fields only (ADR 2026-10-02-richer-requirements); every Slice 0 payload stays valid.

distinctive.description: If true, zero support on the person forces do_not_submit for this job.

mobility.description: Exactly one mobility facet per row.

countries.description: residence: where the person must live or work from (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).

offered.description: visa_sponsorship / relocation_assistance: true offered, false not offered, null not stated.

min_years.description: seniority: minimum years of experience, only when a number is written.

language.description: language: the spoken or written language required (e.g. German).
